summary: Validated Solution Finder ASM placement after the Q2/Q3/Q4 reshuffle. Q2 (renderStep2) confirmed at runtime to have ZERO ASM controls (From-ASM=0, ASM=0, Overall=0). Q3 (renderStep3) and Q4 (renderStep4) confirmed via static review to render renderAsmControls exactly at the spec'd 4 (all_concerns, concern, root_cause, solution) and 3 (risk, mitigation, contingency) levels respectively. UI E2E for Q3/Q4 ASM count assertions was blocked by a Playwright<->React-Native-Web TextInput interaction bug: typing/keyboard input into single-line RN-Web TextInputs (Add a concern, Add a root cause, Add a solution, etc.) does not propagate to the controlled `new*Text` state, so addConcern()/addRca()/addSolution() see an empty string and the row is not created. Same input fails with both `page.fill()`, `page.keyboard.type()` (with delay), and `Enter` (onSubmitEditing). This input-binding bug is NOT introduced by this iteration's change — it pre-existed — but it prevents end-to-end automation of the SF flow. Auth and navigation work, login + reach Solution Finder + step navigation are fine.

integration_issues.flow: Solution Finder · Q1b/Q2/Q3/Q4 row creation via TextInput + 'Add' button
integration_issues.issue: Typing into the single-line TextInput components (placeholders 'Add a concern...', 'Add a root cause...', 'Add a solution...', 'Add a risk...', 'Add a mitigation...', 'Add a contingency...') via Playwright (.fill, keyboard.type, Enter for onSubmitEditing) does not update the controlled React state (newConcernText/newRcaText/newSolText/...). Pressing the '+' button afterwards therefore early-returns at `if (!t) return;` and no row is added. This blocks any browser-automation regression for SF. The likely cause is RN-Web reading the value from a non-standard property path on the DOM element; the workaround is to attach `testID` to each TextInput + add Button and let testing use page.fill + a programmatic state update via `document.querySelector(...)._valueTracker.setValue('') ; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}))`, OR (preferred) expose stable testIDs and rely on `onChangeText` being driven through a small testID-enabled helper.

action_items: ADD testID attributes to each TextInput AND its add (+) TouchableOpacity in solution-finder.tsx (e.g. testID='sf-concern-input' / 'sf-concern-add-btn', testID='sf-rca-input-{cid}' / 'sf-rca-add-btn-{cid}', sf-sol-input-{rid}, sf-risk-input-{solId}, sf-mitigation-input-{rId}, sf-contingency-input-{rId}). This will eliminate the Playwright/RN-Web TextInput binding ambiguity and unblock E2E regression testing.

ADD testID to renderAsmControls cluster itself (e.g. testID=`sf-asm-cluster-${source}-${sourceId}`) so the testing agent can assert exact counts per source — currently we have to fall back to text-content scraping ('From ASM', exact 'ASM') which works but is brittle.
Optional: surface a single hidden marker on Q2 (e.g. testID='sf-step-q2-asm-absent') to make the 'zero ASM on Q2' invariant trivially assertable for future regressions.

renderStep4 (lines 811+) invokes renderAsmControls 3 times: risk (837), mitigation (892), contingency (928) — matches spec (Q4 = 3 ASM levels).
Total = 7 ASM levels across Q3+Q4 (4+3), 0 on Q2 — exactly the corrected placement requested.

renderAsmControls itself (lines 465-482) is properly reused and parameterized by (source, sourceId, label); the 'From ASM' button and 'ASM' send-pill are bundled together so the cluster either appears in full or not at all — no risk of partial mis-placement.
